ldd.description: ldd: shared library dependencies and resolved paths

ldd_r.description: ldd -r: process all relocations — unresolved symbol errors and GLIBC version requirements

readelf.description: readelf -aW: full ELF headers, section table, symbol tables, dynamic section, relocations (--wide prevents truncation)

readelf_n.description: readelf -n: ELF notes — ABI version, build ID, x86 ISA feature flags

readelf_arch.description: readelf -A: architecture-specific attributes — ARM NEON/SVE/FP, RISC-V ISA string, MIPS ABI level

nm.description: nm --demangle -S --special-syms: full symbol table with demangled C++ names and per-symbol sizes (column 2 in hex bytes)

nm_undef.description: nm -u: undefined (external) symbols only — compact list of all external API dependencies (MPI, pthread, BLAS, CUDA runtime, HDF5, etc.)

nm_dynamic.description: nm -D: dynamic symbol table (.dynsym) — survives stripping; shows imported/exported symbols for dynamic linking

size.description: size -A: section sizes (SysV format) — .bss = pre-allocated arrays, .data = initialized static storage

size_b.description: size -B: Berkeley format — text/data/bss/total in one line; quick static memory footprint

strings.description: strings -t x -a -n8: all printable strings (≥8 chars) with hex file offsets — cross-reference offsets with readelf section addresses to identify which section each string comes from

comment.description: objdump -s -j .comment: embedded compiler version string (GCC/Clang) — may reveal -O level, -fopenmp, sanitizers

objdump.description: objdump -DC: full disassembly of all sections with demangled names — grep for ymm/zmm (AVX/AVX-512), call targets, imported symbols

readelf_dwarf.description: readelf -wi -W: DWARF .debug_info — source languages, compilation units, inlined functions

readelf_dwarf_all.description: readelf -w -W: full DWARF dump (all sections) — line tables, frame info, ranges, location lists

outputs.description: radare2 afl: function list with addresses, block counts, and sizes — OMP function variants confirm OpenMP parallel regions
radare2 agCj: global call graph in JSON format — nodes are functions, edges are calls
radare2 pdc: pseudo-C decompilation of all functions — source-like code showing algorithm structure and data flow
angr CFG call graph JSON: {functions: [{addr, name, size, blocks, is_simprocedure, has_return}], calls: [{from_addr, from_name, to_addr, to_name}]}
angr named-function table: total recovered count + per-function address, block count, and byte size — OMP function variants confirm OpenMP parallel regions
angr Decompiler: pseudo-C decompilation of all named functions — source-like code for algorithms and data structures

pahole.description: pahole: struct/union layouts from DWARF — per-object sizes reveal heap allocation footprints

bloaty.description: bloaty -d sections,symbols -n0: binary size ranked by both section and symbol — top symbols dominate static memory

cuobjdump.description: cuobjdump -sass: embedded CUDA fat binary — GPU kernel disassembly, register count, shared memory per kernel

cuobjdump_ptx.description: cuobjdump -ptx: embedded PTX (GPU IR) — compute capability (sm_XX), __shared__ declarations, tensor core intrinsics (mma.sync)

checksec.description: checksec: NX, PIE, RELRO, stack canary, FORTIFY, CFI/CET — security features that affect memory layout, address space, and runtime overhead

llvm_stack_sizes.description: llvm-readobj --stack-sizes: per-function stack frame sizes — predicts per-thread stack memory; only present when compiled with -fstack-size-section (Clang) or equivalent

llvm_dwarf_stats.description: llvm-dwarfdump --statistics: DWARF debug info coverage fractions — indicates reliability of pahole/DWARF-based analyses; low coverage means stripped/optimized build

gdb_functions.description: gdb info functions: function signatures with full parameter types (e.g. void compute(float*, size_t, int)) — cleaner than raw DWARF; only useful with debug info

gdb_types.description: gdb info types: all defined types including C++ template instantiations — filter 'std::' noise; reveals Buffer<float>, Buffer<double>, etc.

outputs.description: Ghidra decompiler: pseudo-C decompilation of all functions — highest quality source-like reconstruction with type recovery
Ghidra headless log: import/analyze status + script runtime
Ghidra: per-function index (addr, size, blocks, stack frame, xrefs in, calls out, loop heuristic)
Ghidra: imported symbols with callsites + caller functions
Ghidra: strings with xrefs + referencing functions
Ghidra: allocation/free-like callsites with best-effort size-arg extraction
